definitions.title: Open Water Orientation Night
definitions.heroSummary: A relaxed first step for new divers who want a clear plan before starting open water training.
definitions.narrative: Open Water Orientation Night gives newer divers and curious families a straightforward walk-through of the certification path, basic gear choices, pool expectations, and how DMZ Scuba structures training without pressure. It is built to answer the questions people usually have before they commit.
definitions.experience: Best for new divers, parents planning for teens, and anyone comparing training options who wants a calm, in-person overview first.
definitions.scheduleNote: Recurring orientation sessions keep the calendar predictable, but each date can still be adjusted or overridden when needed.
whatToExpect: A clear breakdown of the open water certification path
Basic gear and timeline guidance before pool work starts
Time for direct Q&A about readiness, scheduling, and costs

definitions.title: Trip Planning Q&A
definitions.heroSummary: A practical planning session for divers comparing upcoming DMZ travel and trying to pick the right trip window.
definitions.narrative: Trip Planning Q&A is where we break down trip pacing, certification expectations, budget considerations, and who each trip is built for. It helps divers avoid signing up for the wrong itinerary or waiting too long to prepare.
definitions.experience: Good for newer travelers, returning divers rebuilding momentum, and anyone deciding between multiple warm-water trips.
definitions.scheduleNote: This event is tied to a recurring monthly planning cadence so the calendar can keep producing fresh dates automatically.
whatToExpect: Straight answers about timelines and commitment

definitions.title: Skill Refresh Evening Session
definitions.heroSummary: A confidence-building session for certified divers who want a cleaner restart before the season gets busy.
definitions.narrative: Skill Refresh Evening Session is designed for divers who are certified but out of rhythm. We focus on confidence, comfort, and repeated fundamentals so you can step back into local dives, classes, or travel without guessing where you stand.
definitions.experience: Ideal for certified divers returning after time away, pre-trip tune-ups, and anyone who wants to sharpen buoyancy and core habits.
definitions.scheduleNote: This repeating event acts as a standing refresh option that can stay on the calendar while individual dates remain easy to adjust.

definitions.title: Wreck Readiness Workshop
definitions.heroSummary: A focused planning workshop for divers preparing to approach wreck training the right way.
definitions.narrative: Wreck Readiness Workshop helps divers understand the difference between curiosity and readiness. We cover line awareness, team communication, reel discipline, and the mindset required before formal wreck training starts.
definitions.experience: Best for divers looking ahead to overhead-environment training and wanting to understand the preparation honestly.
definitions.scheduleNote: This event uses a repeating schedule template because it works well as a periodic advanced-planning checkpoint.
whatToExpect: A realistic picture of the training path

definitions.title: Local Shore Dive Meetup
definitions.heroSummary: A simple local dive window for certified divers who want time in the water and stronger dive habits.
definitions.narrative: Local Shore Dive Meetup keeps people diving between major classes and bigger travel. It is a low-friction way to stay current, get buddy time, and keep your comfort in the water moving in the right direction.
definitions.experience: Built for certified divers who want community, repetition, and a practical reason to keep diving locally.
definitions.scheduleNote: This event uses a seasonal recurring template so it appears in the warmer-weather window without manual entry each month.
whatToExpect: A casual but intentional local dive session

definitions.title: Summer Travel Briefing Night
definitions.heroSummary: A practical briefing night for divers deciding how to prepare for upcoming travel windows.
definitions.narrative: Summer Travel Briefing Night is where we align real trip timing with certification deadlines, skill readiness, and the best way to move from interested to prepared without rushing the process.
definitions.experience: Strong fit for divers planning warm-water travel who need a realistic certification and prep timeline.
definitions.scheduleNote: This recurring briefing format keeps the travel pipeline visible while still allowing one-off date overrides later.
whatToExpect: A recommended path based on your timeline
